FAILS under the nearest-wrong plain atkPct 10 model (emitted value would be the raw 10) and under target {kind:'self'} (one target).

Same magnitude/target/duration assertions as the Maillard branch; the dwell qualifier ('for more than 1 sec') is separately it.skip'd as unmodelable. Non-vacuity is pinned by asserting the fixture produces both non-charge shots and charge damage.
it.skip — no named-ally-buff removal effect. Same-caster-slot overwrite keeps the ATK magnitude accidentally correct, but the status IDENTITY that burst b/c and skill2 c gate on is unrepresented.

Proves a defPct grant exists and reaches >1 ally (line not silently dropped), AND that stripping every defPct effect leaves totals(res) byte-identical per slug. FAILS if anyone models DEF as a damage source or copy-pastes it as atkPct.
Covered by the same defPct presence + inertness pair; the 'allies NOT in Reliable Cooking' target filter is it.skip'd (no such filter; damage-inert so it costs zero today).
it.skip — no cleanse primitive and the scope-lock boss applies no ally debuffs; unobservable payload.

TRIGGER-IDENTITY discriminator: asserts the distinct apply-frame count of the ~0.20 x crustAtk flat grant equals the fullBurstStart count. FAILS under the nearest-wrong burstCast keying, which fires only on Crust's own casts; a separate counterfactual proves the two models yield different boards, and a strip-run proves the line is load-bearing.

Asserts attackDamagePct emitted with the RAW value 20 (plain percentage stat, not caster-scaled), reaching >1 ally including self, on exactly the frames Crust casts her own burst (burst-slot trigger identity = burstCast, count matches burstCast events), and that stripping it lowers team damage.

Asserts distributedDamagePct 60 is emitted and that NO attackDamagePct carries value 60 — the scope trap is folding a flavor-scoped buff into the generic Damage-Up bucket, which would credit every damage flavor. Flavor-scoping is further pinned by requiring at least one ally to stay byte-identical when the two flavor buffs are stripped. The Maillard-membership gate itself is it.skip'd (ungated model over-credits when the status is absent).
Same shape as the Distributed line: sustainedDamagePct 10 emitted, no generic attackDamagePct with value 10, flavor-scoped inertness on a non-carrier ally; status gate it.skip'd.

ALWAYS-FLAG. it.skip'd with the recipe — both 3-attack thresholds convert to wall clock through the datamined cadence, so every grant's UPTIME inherits the datamine error. Read the ammo counter off a recording for true shots/sec.

fixtures: controlComp('crust', true) for every run — Crust is Burst II, so the control comp's B1/crown-B2/carry/fixed-B3 slots are what let a chain complete and a Full Burst actually open; without that, skill2c (fullBurstEnter) and all three burst lines would be vacuous. The fixed B3 stays enabled because none of Crust's readings are confounded by it (all assertions are on Crust-cast buffApply events filtered by stat+value, or on strip-counterfactual deltas). Deterministic — no seed. Six withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (casterAtkPct->atkPct, allies->self, fullBurstEnter->burstCast, strip attackDamagePct, strip defPct, strip the FB-enter block) plus one inline flavor-strip; 8 total runs, well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill1 a/b (Maillard/Blanching Duration +2.5s) — no duration-EXTENSION effect kind and no ally-side named-status primitive; buff refresh grants a full window, not +2.5s, so modeling it would over-credit.

skill1 c/d 'Removes Blanching/Maillard' — no effect kind removes a specific named ally buff; same-caster-slot overwrite keeps the ATK magnitude right by accident but the status identity is unrepresented.

skill2 a/b 'Affects all allies not in Reliable Cooking status' — no target filter for 'allies lacking a named status'; damage-inert today (defPct) so the mis-scope costs zero, but it would matter if defPct gains a consumer.
skill2 a/b 'Removes 1 debuff' — no cleanse primitive; the scope-lock boss applies no ally debuffs, so the payload is unobservable in v1.

skill2 c + burst b/c status gating on Maillard/Blanching membership — the gate needs ALLY-held named statuses; the only available primitive (requiresTargetStatus) gates on a BOSS status, the wrong entity. Ungated is the only option and OVER-CREDITS whenever the status is genuinely absent — must be stated in the override note.

skill1 d / skill2 b 'maintaining 3 Full Charge for more than 1 sec' — chargeCounter captures the count of 3 full charges but not the >1s dwell qualifier. With chargeFrames 60 the dwell is plausibly always satisfied, but that is a HYPOTHESIS; do not encode a dwell threshold.

⛑ cadence tuple (RL pulls/sec, reloadFrames 141, ammo 6) — datamine-unreliable ALWAYS-FLAG field; both 3-attack thresholds convert to wall clock through it, so every grant's uptime inherits the error. Recipe: frame-read Crust's ammo counter off a recording.
